sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Classified Technologies is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Alright, mate! Picked up a little rumour that, before all this kicked off, some foreign lot tried to smuggle out something valuable through a rat. Didn't go too well, obviously. The thing got stuck somewhere at the Reserve base. Fancy taking a trip over there and having a look? Bring it back here and I'll make it worth your while."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Obtain the package with T-90M Commander control panel on Reserve
- Hand over the package

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Skier Rep +0.75
- 1,650 Euros
  - 1,733 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 1,898 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Knew you could handle it! Here, just like I promised."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| T-90M Commander Control Panel | 1 | Handover item | Yes | The quest item can only be found when this quest is active.; When picked up, it will be placed in the player's quest item inventory.; It will be lost upon death. |
In this quest you have to obtain the package with T-90M Commander control panel on Reserve. It is located behind the dismantled rusty pipe in the underground workshop that has to be passed through to reach the "D2" extraction.
